text:
maya (Product): quick sync — customer Hermes needs private deploy w/ 99th p95 120ms tail. ETA: end of quarter.

sam (Eng): what are the hard blockers for runtime? config, model size, or infra network?

maya (Product): model size + KV cache warmup and routing policy for private. Also need FIPS KMS integration verified by security.

leo (Runtime): model's ~25B, kv/cache cold start will spike QPS. Suggested: warmup prefetch + persistent cache on dedicated nodes. can do a canary for 2 hours.

anika (Infra): network egress rules + VPC peering for customer. Need infra ticket and VPN cert rotation window. I'll need 2 engineers for 3 days to stand up staging peering.

drew (Security): FIPS KMS + audit logs required. Will need key access review and SSO mapping. Also confirm HSM provisioning timeline.

maya (Product): OK. Priorities: (1) get security sign-off (2) infra peering (3) runtime warmup. Customer needs demo by 4/21.

sam (Eng): assigning owners: sam -> warmup + canary rollout plan; anika -> infra peering; drew -> KMS audit. I'll draft rollout config.

sam (Eng): rollout snippet:
```
canary: 10%
duration: 2h
metrics: [latency_95, error_rate]
fallback: use hosted small-model
```

leo (Runtime): note: add KV prefill job: background prefetch 0.5 RPS per user for 24h before demo to populate KV cache.

anika (Infra): blocker: cert rotation window conflicts with other customers on 4/20 00:00-02:00 UTC. Can we shift demo to 4/21 10:00 UTC? :thinking: 

maya (Product): customer says 4/21 morning is fine, prefer earlier but ok to nudge to 10:00 if it avoids risk.

drew (Security): security sign-off checklist:
- KMS audit report
- HSM provisioning confirmation
- RBAC review + SSO mapping
I'll aim to complete by 4/18.

ci-bot: deploy-job #hermes-staging started by sam (Eng) at 2461357950

sam (Eng): I'll open PR for the canary infra + runtime flags today. tag @leo @anika for reviews.

maya (Product): asks: what resourcing delta do you need? if we need >3 engineer-days we should escalate to PM leadership and request a small SOC.

anika (Infra): estimate: 2 engineers x 3 days for peering and certs, 1 engineer x 1 day for staging validation. total 7 engineer-days across teams.

sam (Eng): estimate runtime work: 2 engineers x 4 days (warmup + canary + minor changes).

drew (Security): security work: 1 engineer x 3 days for audits and HSM confirmation.

maya (Product): OK. I'll open a resource request to eng leadership with the breakdown and attach the demo window change. Will ping legal for the KMS POA.

leo (Runtime): quick risk note: if KV prefill is insufficient latency may spike; fallback plan: reduce batch sizes and enable smaller model fallback automatically.

maya (Product): short action list:
- drew: finish security sign-off by 4/18
- anika: infra peering + shift demo -> confirm by 4/17
- sam+leo: canary plan + prefill run by 4/19
- maya: resource request + customer comms by EOD today

sam (Eng): ack. I'll post PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:

anika (Infra): ack

drew (Security): ack

maya (Product): thanks team, keeping this open. will post daily updates in this thread.
